Spine is mattpocock/skills skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs (six phases; thesis is phase 1, build a tight red-capable feedback loop before theorising), with agents/openai.yaml and scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh. simplify-code.notes: Authored 2026-08-29 from three inputs. The standard is Ossian's own 14 rules (skimmable code, minimal state space, discriminated unions, asserts over defensive fallbacks), supplied verbatim in conversation — that is the heart of the skill and has no upstream. Scope resolution, the behavior-preservation contract, and the verify step are structural borrows from EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin docs/guides/ce-simplify-code.md. Three cursor/plugins principle skills are folded in rather than vendored separately: principle-subtract-before-you-add (the subtract-then-collapse-then-polish ordering), principle-laziness-protocol (rules 15-17 and the maintainer-fatigue directive closing the standard), and the transferable half of principle-fix-root-causes (guards are symptom fixes; fix the pattern not the instance). principle-fix-root-causes is ALSO vendored whole as its own skill, since the rest of it is debugging guidance that does not belong here. The adversarial re-read loop encodes Ossian's practice of pushing a model past its first simplification; it dispatches two bundled reviewer personas (references/reviewers/) written here, following the persona-file pattern used by EveryInc's ce-code-review references/personas/ and by our own skill-creator agents/, rather than a host-specific agent registry. No file is reproduced from either source, so there is nothing to pin; re-read both if they change.
